analyst.summary: City Union Bank is a long-established Tamil Nadu-based private bank focused on MSME and gold-loan lending, alongside broader corporate and retail banking. The bank has shown accelerating growth in its most recent quarters -- profit, deposits and advances have all grown strongly -- while bad-loan levels have continued to improve, reflecting disciplined underwriting even as the loan book expands. The stock has re-rated substantially over the past two years on this improving trend. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely well-run, improving regional bank, with much of the good news already reflected in a share price that has more than doubled over two years.
